title: Manager-Legal Officer
description:
**About Company**

HiLITE Properties, a key division of HiLITE Group, brings “The Finer Side of Life” to the real estate sector in Kerala. Established in 2021, the company has rapidly grown into one of the region’s notable real estate developers. With landmark projects such as HiLITE Mall Thrissur and HiLITE Boulevard, HiLITE Properties has built a strong reputation for quality and innovation. The team focuses on creating distinctive commercial and residential spaces that elevate community living and business experiences. Professionals joining HiLITE Properties can expect a dynamic environment with opportunities to contribute to high-visibility projects.

**Role Description**
:

The Manager / Legal Officer – Corporate will be responsible for handling corporate legal matters, reviewing and drafting legal documents, ensuring statutory compliance, managing legal risks, and providing legal support to various departments. The role involves safeguarding the company’s legal interests and ensuring that business operations comply with applicable laws and regulations.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Draft, review, and vet legal agreements, contracts, MoUs, notices, deeds, and other corporate documents.
* Handle corporate legal matters and provide legal advice to management and internal departments.
* Ensure compliance with applicable corporate laws, statutory requirements, and regulatory guidelines.
* Review commercial contracts, vendor agreements, lease agreements, and other business-related legal documents.
* Coordinate with external advocates, legal consultants, government authorities, and other stakeholders.
* Manage legal notices, disputes, litigation, and related documentation.
* Conduct legal due diligence and verify property-related documents, title deeds, and other legal records, wherever required.
* Monitor compliance with applicable real estate regulations, including RERA, where relevant.
* Identify potential legal risks and recommend appropriate preventive measures.
* Maintain and update legal records, agreements, case files, and compliance documents.
* Coordinate with HR, Finance, Sales, Projects, and other departments on legal matters.
* Track changes in applicable laws and advise management on their implications.
* Ensure the confidentiality and proper handling of sensitive legal documents and company information.

Interested candidates can share their updated CV or

Apply directly

title: IPR Trainee
description:
**Company Description**
Bizpole supports businesses across India with end-to-end services, including registration, virtual accounting, tax filing, and compliance, so clients can focus on growth. Since 2020, the company has been contributing to the entrepreneurial ecosystem and building a strong presence across the country. Bizpole has served more than 8,000 customers, with a high recommendation rate and operations in over 50 cities. The company’s strong customer satisfaction is reflected in its 4.6+ Google rating, highlighting its commitment to reliable and efficient business services.

**Job description:**

About the Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented IPR Trainee with formal legal training and Bar enrollment to assist in intellectual property matters including patents, trademarks, and copyrights. The role offers practical exposure to IP filings, legal research, and advisory work.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct trademark searches, patent prior art searches, and IP due diligence
* Assist in drafting trademark applications, objections, replies, and copyright filings
* Support preparation of legal opinions and IP advisory notes
* Monitor IP filings, deadlines, and status updates
* Perform legal research on IP laws, case laws, and regulatory updates
* Assist in handling IP infringement matters and dispute documentation
* Maintain organized records of IP portfolios

**Requirements**

* LL.B./LL.M. graduate
* Enrolled with Bar Council will be additional advantage
* Strong understanding of Intellectual Property Laws
* Excellent legal research and drafting skills
* Good command of English & Malayalam
* High attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines

**Learning Opportunities**

* Hands-on exposure to IP filings and prosecution
* Drafting legal documents and responses
* Understanding real-world IP strategy and enforcement

title: Regulatory Compliance Specialist
description:
We are seeking a dedicated Regulatory Compliance Specialist to join our team in Kerala. The ideal candidate will play a crucial role in ensuring that our organization adheres to all regulatory requirements and internal compliance standards. This position is essential for maintaining the integrity and reputation of our operations while minimizing risks associated with non-compliance. Key Responsibilities: - Develop, implement, and monitor compliance programs to ensure adherence to regulatory requirements. - Conduct regular audits and assessments to identify areas of risk and ensure compliance with internal policies and external regulations. - Collaborate with various departments to provide guidance on compliance-related issues and best practices. - Stay updated on changes in regulations and industry standards, and communicate these changes to relevant stakeholders. - Prepare and submit compliance reports to management and regulatory bodies as required. - Provide training and support to staff on compliance matters to foster a culture of compliance within the organization. Required Skills: - Strong understanding of regulatory frameworks and internal compliance processes. - Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. - Ability to communicate complex compliance issues clearly and effectively. - Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills. - Proficient in using compliance management software and tools. If you are passionate about regulatory compliance and are looking for an opportunity to make a significant impact within a dynamic organization, we encourage you to apply for this position. Join us in ensuring that our operations meet the highest standards of compliance and integrity.
